### How the Columbus Fire Department Saw Safety-Driven Results for its Community

The Columbus Fire Department, ranked as the 14th largest in the nation, is always committed to finding new and innovative ways to ensure the safety of its community and crew. The department even has its own research and development team, which has a specialized focus on firefighter safety.

In the spring of 2023, Columbus Fire activated Safety Cloud® digital alerting. Over the past year, their research and development team has conducted a thorough analysis to assess the impact Safety Cloud has had on the community since going live. The results of this analysis are now available.
